articles.headline: Chase Elliott wins Straight Talk Wireless 400 (NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race)
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Chase Elliott won Straight Talk Wireless 400 (NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race) at Homestead-Miami Speedway, starting P14 and leading 68 laps. Christopher Bell finished second and Joey Logano was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 8 cautions.

Tyler Reddick was the biggest mover, gaining 30 spots from P35 to P5.

Joey Logano leads the championship with 1268 points, 77 ahead of Denny Hamlin.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
